annotations.title: Start-up grants and loans from the labour office and PFRON in Poland, and the sickness benefit after the end of employment

description: Use for money to start a business in Poland (start-up grant of the labour office, PFRON grant for a person with a disability, start-up loan, local action group premium), the labour office education loan, and whether the sickness benefit (zasiłek chorobowy) is paid after the end of employment and until when. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Money to start a business in Poland, with amounts in PLN from the average wage in force today (GUS announcement): start-up grant of the district labour office up to 6 times the average wage (keep the business for 12 months), PFRON grant for a person with a disability up to 15 times (24 months), social cooperative grant up to 6 times per member, start-up loan from the Labour Fund up to 20 times at 0.25% a year for up to 7 years with remission of up to 6 times, education loan of the labour office up to 400% interest free, and the local action group (LEADER) premium (amount set by each group). Gives the conditions, repayment rules, legal articles and the next amount when GUS already announced a new average wage. With employment_end and sickness_start: checks whether ZUS pays the sickness benefit after the end of employment (inability to work starting within 14 days, or 3 months for infectious diseases with a long incubation, lasting at least 30 days, up to 91 days after the end; exclusions of art. 13) and gives the last payable day. A calculation, not a decision of the labour office or ZUS.

employment_end.description: Last day of employment (sickness insurance), YYYY-MM-DD. Give it with sickness_start for the sickness benefit check.

long_incubation.description: Infectious disease with incubation over 14 days or symptoms after more than 14 days: 3-month window. Default false.

pregnancy_or_tb.description: Pregnancy or tuberculosis: no 91-day limit. Default false.

sickness_end.description: Last day of the sick leave, YYYY-MM-DD; optional (gives the paid days).

sickness_start.description: First day of the inability to work, YYYY-MM-DD.
